summary: Batch job hangs indefinitely when given a malformed query instead of failing with an error. Expected behavior is to validate the query upfront and fail fast with an error message, similar to CLI behavior.
userImpact: Users cannot use batch operations with malformed queries as the operation hangs indefinitely instead of providing immediate feedback about the query error.
rootCause: Missing query validation in batch operation endpoint - queries are not validated upfront like they are in the CLI
proposedFix: Add upfront query validation to batch operations to catch malformed queries before execution, matching CLI behavior
resolutionDetails: Fixed in #9793 - will be included in next OSS and Cloud release
